scope: New reaction-level evaluation; existing planner and forward verification protocols unchanged
reference_kind: Expert-labelled model proposals; not experimental success/failure records
grouping: RDKit canonical product constitution with isomericSmiles=False, used only for split grouping; identity-v1 stays unchanged for all matching
split: sha256('ChemLab-chemical-reference-2026-10-31:' + grouping_key) modulo 5; remainder 4 final_reference; others development
duplicate_policy: Preserve raw rows; score each full identity-v1 reaction once; conflicting expert labels are reference conflicts, not binary truth
final_evidence_exclusion: Exclude exact final-reference reaction identities from operational precedent evidence during evaluation; never insert benchmark reactions or labels into knowledge indexes
constraints: No checker access to labels or scorer-generated fields. No final-outcome tuning. Record classifier policy hash before final scoring. Existing 14 user-selected routes are development cases only.
